picks.episode_title: College Football Week 8 Betting Preview: BYU-UCF, LSU-Auburn, & Indiana-Michigan with Wes Reynolds & Brett Ciancia (@PickSixPreviews)
picks.quote: I'm going to play UCF at a principal. I did play them on Sunday.
picks.reason: UCF is in a strong situational spot after a bye week, while BYU may struggle after a big win.
picks.edge: The situational spot favors UCF coming off a bye while BYU is coming off a big win.

picks.episode_title: College Football Week 8 Betting Preview: BYU-UCF, LSU-Auburn, & Indiana-Michigan with Wes Reynolds & Brett Ciancia (@PickSixPreviews)
picks.quote: I'm on South Carolina here on the money line.
picks.reason: South Carolina has momentum after a bye and a strong performance against Florida, while Tennessee is struggling.
picks.edge: South Carolina is coming off a bye and has shown improvement, while Tennessee is fatigued after a tough schedule.

picks.episode_title: College Football Week 8 Betting Preview: BYU-UCF, LSU-Auburn, & Indiana-Michigan with Wes Reynolds & Brett Ciancia (@PickSixPreviews)
picks.quote: I actually did bet NIU plus four and a half. It'll be a best bet on the pod tomorrow.
picks.reason: Brett believes NIU can finally secure their first win against Hawaii.
picks.edge: NIU is 0-6 but still playing hard; Hawaii has been disappointing.

picks.episode_title: College Football Week 8 Betting Preview: BYU-UCF, LSU-Auburn, & Indiana-Michigan with Wes Reynolds & Brett Ciancia (@PickSixPreviews)
picks.quote: I would lean a little bit North Dakota State because this is another Mountain West road trip for them.
picks.reason: Brett thinks North Dakota State might be better prepared for this matchup.

picks.episode_title: College Football Week 8 Betting Preview: BYU-UCF, LSU-Auburn, & Indiana-Michigan with Wes Reynolds & Brett Ciancia (@PickSixPreviews)
picks.quote: So give me Indiana with the touchdown on the road.
picks.reason: Brett believes Indiana is significantly better than Michigan and can cover the spread.
picks.edge: I think they're more than a touchdown better than Michigan.

picks.episode_title: College Football Week 8 Betting Preview: BYU-UCF, LSU-Auburn, & Indiana-Michigan with Wes Reynolds & Brett Ciancia (@PickSixPreviews)
picks.quote: I like LSU here with seven and a half.
picks.reason: Brett thinks LSU will perform well against Auburn after their recent victory.
picks.edge: LSU is coming off a strong shutout win and Auburn may be overvalued after their upset.

picks.episode_title: College Football Week 8 Betting Preview: BYU-UCF, LSU-Auburn, & Indiana-Michigan with Wes Reynolds & Brett Ciancia (@PickSixPreviews)
picks.quote: Give me the Kansas state power run game... I think they're gonna win by more than the field goal.
picks.reason: Brett expects Kansas State to dominate the game with their running game.
picks.edge: Kansas State has a strong rushing offense against a weak rushing defense.
